rows.rule: Left = outline figures, Right = solid figures
Left = elongated figures, Right = compact figures
Left = Spirals are counterclockwise., Right = Spirals are clockwise.
Left = Shapes are symmetrical., Right = Shapes are asymmetrical.
Left = Dots are on the inside of the shape., Right = Dots are on the outside of the shape.
Left = solid figures, Right = outline figures
Left = All dots are inside the shape., Right = At least one dot is outside the shape.
Left = Circles are on the outside of curves., Right = Circles are on the inside of curves.
Left = Triangle points up, Right = Triangle points down
Left = Shapes are different from each other., Right = Shapes are the same as each other.
Left = Single closed curve, Right = Single open curve
Left = All shapes are different., Right = At least two shapes are the same.
Left = nonconvex figures, Right = convex figures
Left = One circle among plus signs, Right = Two circles among plus signs
Left = Square outside the circle of dots, Right = Square inside the circle of dots
Left = Shapes have three lines or sides., Right = Shapes have more than three lines or sides.
Left = Shapes have three endpoints., Right = Shapes have more than three endpoints.
Left = Even number of shapes, Right = Odd number of shapes
Left = Contains at least one acute angle, Right = Does not contain any acute angles
Left = All lines are made of alternating filled and unfilled circles., Right = All lines are made of either all filled or all unfilled circles.
